scope: One reader-service capability test; no activation/rotor/workflow claim
preconditions: Matching immutable 3a app already in the foreground; no app install, launch or build performed by the test method
Preserve existing data/cohort and the original reader enabled state
Use only candidate003; candidate002 is superseded
actions: Capture one initialAppState and fail unless it is runningForeground
Read and attach the original isEnabled value
Restore the original enabled state, including enable if originally true and unexpectedly false
Attach the final state and preserve both operation and restoration errors
failed_to_stop_policy: Keep the raw NSError domain, code and description plus final enabled state
The test fails even if a later getter matches the original state
No automatic retry, ordinary tap, rotor action or fallback
Do not return the lane until Root verifies recovery; a process crash also requires owner restoration
no_runtime_claim: No VoiceOver service operation has executed yet
A build-only probe is not an app workflow, audio or hardware result
